raw_blocks: As a trusted global leader in energy efficiency technology, we design and manufacture reliable, high-performance solutions that generate cost savings and reduce energy consumption for industries such as desalination & wastewater.
See Our Latest Technology Watch Video

As the global need for freshwater becomes more critical, desalination—the process of turning saline water into freshwater—is becoming more important with each passing day. However, as vital as the process is, desalination consumes a significant amount of energy. We’re here to change that.
Membrane technologies now offer an energy-efficient and cost-effective way to meet regulations requiring minimal liquid discharge (MLD) and zero liquid discharge (ZLD) for wastewater treatment.
Our revolutionary PX ® Pressure Exchanger ® is recognized globally as a trusted, reliable, high-performing energy efficiency device.

Our PX technology uses a ceramic rotor to efficiently capture and transfer pressure energy. By making processes more efficient and environmentally sustainable, the PX can lower costs, save energy, and minimize emissions.
Our line of PX devices is able to handle liquid, gas, liquid with suspended solids, and supercritical fluids, and is ideal for a wide range of pressure ratings from low to ultra-high.
The PX’s ceramic rotor acts as a fluid piston, efficiently transferring energy between high-pressure and low-pressure liquid and/or gas through continuously rotating ducts.

When the PX first entered the market over 30 years ago in desalination, it was an industry-changing technology that made new treatment processes commercially viable. Today, many industries benefit from this technology, and we continue to explore new applications.

pages.raw_meta: Energy Recovery is a global leader in energy efficiency technology. Learn how we create high-performance solutions that the industry trusts.
raw_blocks: Energy Recovery (Nasdaq: ERII) designs and manufactures world-class energy-saving technology for critical infrastructure that communities rely on every day, driving a more resilient and sustainable future. Grounded in more than 30 years of leadership in the desalination industry, today we use our proprietary pressure exchanger technology to help customers in multiple industries improve their operations and lower their emissions. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, we operate manufacturing and R&D facilities throughout California, with sales and on-site technical support available globally.
Our energy recovery devices save our customers approximately USD $8 billion in energy costs annually.

Our core pressure exchanger technology is at the heart of many of our products. It is designed to efficiently capture and transfer pressure energy, making commercial and industrial processes more efficient and environmentally sustainable, lowering costs, saving energy, and minimizing emissions.

Our first application of our technology, the PX ® Pressure Exchanger ® , revolutionized seawater desalination by addressing a key pain point: energy intensity. The PX reduces energy use by up to 60% in desalination facilities – significant savings that improve our customers’ operational profitability while reducing carbon emissions. Today, we deliver PX-based solutions for desalination and wastewater treatment, and we continue to push the boundaries of what our pressure exchanger can do.

Metric tons of carbon emissions avoided *
Equivalent vehicle emissions removed from the road *
